_comment: #1890/#1891 — mutation testing of Harvey's declared guards with a blocking reviewed baseline.
GUARD_SET in src/guard-mutation-census.ts is the authoritative guard population.
Run src/cli/guard-mutation-census.ts to partition every declared guard before execution,
isolate each in-place Stryker process in an exact-commit checkout, retain raw artifacts,
and pass the verified normalized aggregate to the production baseline comparator.
thresholds.break remains null: Stryker emits the full population; the comparator owns the verdict.
inPlace preserves the Git-backed discovery guards. Only private shard checkouts are instrumented.
src/recorded-reasons.ts is absent from mutate but remains a declared exclusion shard.
Its fresh instrumented dry run must reproduce a concrete failure; success makes the exclusion stale.
Generated dry-run mutants are recorded as exclusion evidence, never counted as scored mutants.
The shard manifest retains this exact base configuration and every derived effective configuration.
Historical baseline receipts keep their original configuration digests; a new run never rewrites them.
